name: Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim Gold & Acrylic Calligraphy
short_desc: This high-end hand-painted acrylic artwork displays Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim (Surah Yaseen: 58) in elegant white script set against a deep lapis lazuli cobalt background. Detailed with dramatic liquid gold fracture textures and sealed with a gloss varnish finish, it adds regal luxury and modern sophistication to any accent wall or dining room.
description:
Transform your space into a sanctuary of fine-art luxury with this stunning Islamic calligraphy artwork. The piece features the comforting verse Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim ("Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord - Surah Yaseen: 58), exquisitely hand-painted in fluid white Arabic typography across the center of the composition.

Crafted using high-grade acrylic paints, the design showcases a rich, jewel-toned backdrop inspired by genuine lapis lazuli, filled with deep cobalt blue, royal blue, and subtle dark oceanic undertones. Striking liquid gold fracture veins and shimmering metallic gold dust crackle across the canvas, creating a dramatic high-contrast effect that catches light from every angle.

To preserve the artwork’s rich color depth and ensure long-term durability, it is sealed with a protective gloss varnish finish. This varnish coating guards the acrylic layers against dust, moisture, and color fading over time while adding a luminous shine that enhances the gold leaf detailing.

Framed in a sleek black frame with an inner gold lip, this luxurious piece serves as an eye-catching focal point for formal dining rooms, living room feature walls, grand foyers, or modern office spaces.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints with gold fracture detailing

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for enhanced color richness and longevity

Theme & Script: Salamun Qawlam Mir Rabbir Rahim (Surah Yaseen: 58)

Color Palette: Deep lapis lazuli cobalt blue background, crisp white calligraphy, accented with liquid gold cracking veins

Style: Modern Luxury Jewel-Tone / Abstract Islamic Calligraphy Fusion

Ideal Placement: Feature accent wall, formal dining room, modern living space, or executive suite
